text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed Mejiro Ramonu to the infirmary 
after she got injured during training.
choice_data_list:
With these symptoms, you'll need to rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Such an overdramatic person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"This is nothing serious. I'm heading back 
to the track."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Would you mind stepping aside?
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm—...calm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is stiff. She seems aware 
herself that frustration is getting the 
better of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being torn away from the racing she loves 
because of a severe injury... that thought 
is likely throwing her heart into turmoil. 
If so—
choice_data_list:
The race isn't going anywhere! You'll be 
fine!!
At least let me adjust your training menu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're speaking awfully loud. Whatever 
could be so important――
choice_data_list:
Even if you push yourself right now, you 
won't be able to run the races you love!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—...Phew. I'll take a break. I've grasped 
it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Acting purely on emotion is nothing short 
of disgraceful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She shot me a glance, but there was no 
anger in it. It seems she managed to come 
around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes... That would be splendid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm back... Now then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Stop! Let's take a break already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—...How unsightly. You are quite welcome 
to laugh at me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having worsened her injury, Mejiro Ramonu 
quietly cast her eyes downward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahaha...!!
choice_data_list:
Impressive... Looks like that injury won't 
be a problem.

Amazing... Looks like your injury won't be 
an issue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah... this is fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in the face of adversity, Mejiro 
Ramonu's love remains absolute—I felt the 
overwhelming depth of her devotion.
